拖动、打开菜单、暂停、隐藏、重置位置或调整大小会取消正在进行的互动，并让刚才的动: Dragging, opening a menu, pausing, hiding, resetting positions, or resizing cancels the current interaction, starts its cooldown, and starts the shared rest period.
条件不满足、没有真正开始的请求，不产生冷却。: Requests that cannot start do not trigger cooldowns.
暂停、打开菜单或隐藏时，冷却继续计时。恢复前，角色不会自己互动。重启程序会重新开: Cooldowns continue while paused, in menus, or hidden. Automatic interactions wait until activity resumes. Restarting the app resets the session's cooldown records.

Reorder with ↑ / ↓ and remove the current line with −. Each line allows up to 160 characters and 4 line breaks, displayed for 1–60 seconds. A script can contain up to 200 lines.
编辑后自动保存，也可点击「保存」。可复制或删除整个剧本。点击「播放」后，两人暂时: Edits save automatically; you can also select Save. Scripts can be copied or deleted. Play holds both pets idle while their bubbles appear in sequence. Pause/Resume controls playback; Stop restores their previous activity state. Closing the editor does not stop playback. Reopen it from Tools. Edits made during playback take effect when you restart playback.
拖动、隐藏、重置位置、更改角色大小或切换桌宠暂停状态都会停止对白。气泡可以点穿，: Dragging, hiding, resetting positions, resizing, or changing the pets' pause state stops dialogue. Bubbles are click-through. This feature works offline and never uploads scripts. Scripts are stored in stories/library.json in the local Godot user data directory, with a .bak copy of the previous save. Back up both files before switching computers.
右键角色 → 工具 → 每日闹钟: Right-click a character → Tools → Daily alarm
按 24 小时制选择时、分，点击「开启每日闹钟」。每天按本机时间提醒一次；若今天: Choose an hour and minute in 24-hour format, then Enable daily alarm. It reminds you once a day using your computer's local time. If today's time has passed, it starts tomorrow. The window shows the next reminder date. There is one alarm; both pets open the same window.
开启状态和提醒时间会保存，重启桌宠后继续使用。关闭窗口、暂停角色或隐藏桌宠不会关: The enabled state and time are saved across restarts. Closing the window, pausing, or hiding the pets does not disable the alarm. A reminder appears without taking keyboard focus, with an optional short chime. Got it dismisses today's reminder; tomorrow's remains scheduled. Disable alarm stops daily reminders. Change time disables the alarm before editing.
桌宠退出期间不会提醒，重新启动也不会补发退出期间错过的提醒。电脑休眠时不会唤醒电: The alarm cannot run while the pet app is closed, and missed reminders are not replayed after restarting. It does not wake a sleeping computer. If the app remained running, missed reminders are combined into one after waking. The alarm follows local date and time, with at most one reminder per local date.
